label: Old exonuclease system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses an Old exonuclease locus represented by DefenseFinder as a single-profile model, Old_exonuclease__Old_exonuclease, and experimentally linked to interference with phage lambda by the bacteriophage P2 Old protein.
observations: Old_exonuclease branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Old proteins, the DefenseFinder Old_exonuclease__Old_exonuclease profile, the P2 Tin accessory protein, RecBCD inhibition, lambda interference outside a complete Old_exonuclease locus, unvalidated RefSeq examples, and other phage-defense systems.
